title: Global classification of oscillatory dynamics in symmetric zero-divergence 3D piecewise-linear Filippov systems with a visible--visible two-fold
summary: A global classification of the asymptotic oscillatory dynamics is established for a symmetric zero-divergence class of three-dimensional piecewise-linear Filippov systems, up to a set of initial conditions of zero Lebesgue measure. The affine fields are related by an involution, and the switching plane contains a visible--visible two-fold. In canonical coordinates, the eigenvalues are \(μ\pm i\) and \(-2μ\), while \(H\) measures the focal-line inclination.
